supported_fields.unlock_method: Complete PQ8 with an Ultimate Finish
supported_fields.mechanics: Universal CaC Awoken with Kaioken, Kaioken x3, and Kaioken x20 stages. Current maintained evidence records increasing Ki thresholds and escalating stamina drain; x3 and x20 provide progressively larger offensive boosts with increasingly severe defense/drain tradeoffs.

limits: The repository preserves unresolved probability/guarantee semantics where generic PQ condition text is insufficient; the Ultimate Finish acquisition endpoint itself is retained.
Exact frame data and version-specific balance changes are not inferred.
Stage bonuses are bounded to the maintained current skill evidence rather than generalized to every patch/version.
